{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check value counts for key variables
arm_counts = trial_df['arm'].value_counts()
responded_counts = trial_df['responded'].value_counts()

# Check if 'responded' is binary and properly coded
print(f'Missing values per column:\n{missing_values}\n')
print(f'Arm distribution:\n{arm_counts}\n')
print(f'Responded distribution:\n{responded_counts}\n')"}
